extended:
**CUSP SHAPE AND TUNNEL NUMBER**

*VINH DANG AND JESSICA S. PURCELL*

15 pp, 10 sections.

**Abstract.** We show that the set of cusp shapes of hyperbolic tunnel number one manifolds is dense in the Teichm¨uller space of the torus. A similar result holds for tunnel number n manifolds. As a consequence, for ﬁxed n, there are inﬁnitely many hyperbolic tunnel number n manifolds with at most one exceptional Dehn ﬁlling. This is in contrast to large volume Berge knots, which are tunnel number one manifolds, but with cusp shapes converging to a single point in Teichm¨uller space.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 Hyperbolic structures on compression bodies; 1.1 Acknowledgements; 2.1 Hyperbolic structures; 3 Spaces of hyperbolic structures; 4 Pinched handlebodies; 5 Cusp shapes of tunnel number n manifolds; 6 Exceptional fillings; References
